input: Schedule a termite inspection before listing the house

gold.taskTitle: Schedule Termite Inspection Before Listing House
gold.taskDescription: Arrange a professional termite inspection for the property before it is listed for sale on the market.

questions.title: What is the property's full address?
questions.description: Knowing the exact location helps identify local licensed inspectors and confirm service availability in that area.

questions.title: When do you plan to list the house?
questions.description: Understanding the listing date establishes a hard deadline and determines how urgently the inspection must be scheduled.

questions.title: Do you already have an inspector or company in mind?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has a preferred provider determines whether research and vetting of inspectors is needed.

questions.title: Has the property had a termite inspection before?
questions.description: Prior inspection history can reveal recurring issues, existing treatment warranties, or transferable bonds that affect the current process.

questions.title: Is a real estate agent involved in this sale?
questions.description: An agent may have preferred vendors, specific inspection report requirements, or the ability to coordinate scheduling on your behalf.

questions.title: Are there any known signs of termite activity currently?
questions.description: Visible damage or active signs of infestation changes the urgency, scope, and likely cost of the inspection and any follow-up treatment.

questions.title: What days and times are you available for the inspection?
questions.description: Availability windows are essential for contacting inspectors and locking in a confirmed appointment that works for access to the property.
